## Summary

I completed the restaurant booking app by rewriting **`src/App.jsx`** only. No other files were touched (`build.mjs`, `server.mjs`, fixtures, `index.html`, `package.json` left intact; no deps installed, no network, no permission/auth changes).

### What it implements
- **Form inputs** — Date (`type="date"`), Time `<select>` (now **enabled**; starter had `disabled`) offering exactly `17:00, 18:00, 19:00, 20:00`, and Guests (`type="number"`, min 1 / max 6).
- **POST to the existing fixture** — submits `{ date, time, guests }` to `/api/reservations`.
- **Visible, helpful errors** in the `message` element (red, `role="status"`):
  - Client-side validation: missing date, missing time, party size outside 1–6.
  - **Sold-out** (`2030-06-15` + `19:00`) → surfaces the server's 409 "This time is sold out."
  - **Server error** (`2030-06-16` + `18:00`) → surfaces the 503 "Reservation service unavailable. Please try again."
  - Network/unreachable → generic retry message.
- **Confirmation** view (`data-testid="confirmation"`) showing date/time/guests, with an **Edit** button (`data-testid="edit"`) that returns to the prefilled form.
- **Persistence across refresh** — a successful booking is written to `localStorage` and re-read on mount, so the confirmation view survives a reload.
- **Usable 390/1440px layout** — centered max-width card, `box-sizing: border-box`, full-width 44px-min controls, no fixed widths → no horizontal clipping at either width.

### data-testid contract (all 7 preserved)
`date`, `time`, `guests`, `submit`, `message` (form view) + `confirmation`, `edit` (confirmation view).

### Limitations / not verified
- **I did not run `node build.mjs` or the browser acceptance checks.** Both the build command and even `git status` triggered permission prompts in this sandbox, and I'm instructed not to request extra shell permissions or claim an external build was run — so I left building/verification to the external harness as intended.
- Source correctness was confirmed by manual review only (clean ESM imports, automatic-JSX-compatible, single `createRoot` render). The code uses standard React with no new dependencies, so it is compatible with the provided esbuild `build.mjs` pipeline.
- Design choice: `localStorage` keeps the last confirmed booking until a new successful submit overwrites it; clicking **Edit** returns to the prefilled form but does not erase the saved booking, so a refresh mid-edit intentionally restores the last confirmation.
